bugs_fixed_this_session: Architecture mismatch: main-branch model uses model.region.coord_decoder/size_decoder (newer SAM-style); candle-transformers 0.8 expects PhiModel-based text_model.transformer.embd.wte.weight. Fixed by pinning download URL to 2024-03-04 revision tag.

F16+CPU process crash: candle 0.8 lacks F16 CPU kernels for some Moondream ops, producing exit 0xffffffff deep in vision encoder forward. Fixed by removing F16 try-first path in load() and using F32 directly (~7 GB resident vs ~3.7 GB).

Rank-2 logits sample failure: forward_with_img returns [batch, vocab] = [1, 51200] but LogitsProcessor.sample expects rank-1 [V]. Fixed with raw_logits.squeeze(0) on priming + same squeeze in autoregressive loop.
